notes._comment: Exocortex Inference Wrapper — Layer B of the two-layer architecture
notes._model_path: Update model_path to point to your GGUF file
notes._chat_format: CRITICAL: must match the model's expected template. 'qwen' for Qwen family.
notes._logits_all: Set to true to enable per-token entropy monitoring. Increases VRAM usage.
notes._type_k_v: KV cache quantization. 1=f16 (default), 8=q8_0 (50% savings), 2=q4_0 (75% savings, LOSSLESS on Qwen3.5). Use 8 as safe default.
notes._model_management: POST /v1/model/unload to free VRAM before gaming. POST /v1/model/load to reload.
notes._kv_slots: Future: pre-computed KV caches for zero-token BST enrichment (Knowledge Packs)
